ethics_assessment.self_assessment_statement: In accordance with the Tier 1 requirement that applicants complete an ethics self-assessment as part of the application (implementation_constraints.json, ethics_self_assessment_required; source: wp-15-general-annexes_horizon-2026-2027 p.16 and programme-guide pp.25-28), this action has completed an ethics self-assessment. The self-assessment addresses the ethical dimension of the objectives, methodology and likely impact, and compliance with ethical principles and relevant legislation, including the appraisal domains covered by Tier 1 (ethics_appraisal_summary) and the civil-only focus constraint (civil_focus_constraint). The principal ethics dimension identified is the development and deployment of AI-based predictive and decision-support systems (see ETH-01), which is grounded in the WP3 and WP5 activities in wp_structure.json; the human-rights and values dimension of these AI systems is considered and addressed. The Tier 3 compliance_profile.json records ethics_review_required: true as a compliance flag derived during call binding; no Tier 2B extracted source path cites an ethics review as a topic-specific mandate for this call, so this is treated as a Tier 3 derivative flag rather than a confirmed call-specific mandate. On the gender dimension: integration of the gender dimension in research and innovation content follows the Tier 1 default rule that it is mandatory unless the topic explicitly states non-relevance (implementation_constraints.json, gender_dimension_in_content). No Tier 2B exemption source is currently cited in this Phase 6 artifact; Phase 8 drafting must either add the relevant Tier 2B topic-source reference or keep the claim framed as pending call-specific confirmation. Beneficiaries must also promote equal opportunities and aim, to the extent possible, for gender balance at all levels of personnel assigned to the action, including supervisory and managerial level (gender_management_balance_guidance).
